name: Family Faring
source:
Being a father of two, and recently being allowed to see your girls again, it's your quest to prove yourself as a father. In this Visual Novel, you will have to navigate through good and evil, innocent and corrupt as the relationship with the daughters evolves. Along this journey, you will encounter a plentitude of gorgeous women.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
作为两个孩子的父亲，最近又被允许再次见到你的女儿们，这是你证明自己作为一个父亲的追求。在这部视觉小说中，随着与女儿们关系的发展，你将不得不在善与恶、无辜与腐败之间穿梭。在这段旅程中，你会遇到很多美丽的女人。

[来自Itch.io]
